meaning: Named case ports only. Consolidated Rust checks and Rails contract vectors are additional evidence, not file closure.

boundary_deferred.test/models/agent_credential_test.rb: The unknown/blank secret case runs against the str domain input. Conversion of absent HTTP credentials (Rails nil.to_s) remains with WS11-api.
boundary_deferred.test/models/agent_test.rb: The badge/directory HTML and absence of secrets in rendered HTML remain WS11-ui cases (two unmapped names). The reset-lock comparison checks the actual serialized writer transaction instead of a Ruby method spy.
boundary_deferred.test/services/slash_commands/dispatcher_: Five agent invocations compared here; 35 built-in command cases remain WS8.
boundary_deferred.test/models/message_streaming_test.rb: 18 domain and production-sweep cases compared; five actual rendered start/trailing, activity and link-reference cases await their peer adapters. Never-resume checks the same validation through persistence instead of Rails valid?.
boundary_deferred.test/models/agent_approval_test.rb: The preference-neighbour case also asserts an ordinary mention inbox item; its approval preference and decider half is already checked in the consolidated vectors, but the complete named case awaits WS12 activity installation.
